---
title: "Charting Waterloo Region"
subtitle: "Charts and plain-language analysis about life in Waterloo Region, built from open data."
# The preview picture shown when someone pastes a link to the site into a chat app
# or posts it. Without this, Quarto hands a listing page the image of whichever
# post happens to be at the top, so a link to the home page previewed as the newest
# post - the site card is what belongs on a link to the site.
image: images/social-card.png
listing:
  contents: "posts/*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
  # No reading-time field: Quarto's estimate counts table cells and runs far too high.
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories]
  image-placeholder: images/thumbnail-placeholder.png
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
toc: false
---
